# Google Ad Traffic Quality
> Google’s ad traffic quality site explains invalid activity, ad fraud defenses, and best practices for advertisers and publishers.

This site provides guidance on how Google detects, prevents, and responds to invalid traffic across its advertising systems, with dedicated resources for both advertisers and publishers.

## Core Documentation
- [Overview](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/overview/): Introduction to Google’s approach to protecting ad ecosystems from invalid activity.
- [Invalid activity](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/invalid-activity/): Defines invalid activity and explains common forms of ad fraud and improper traffic.
- [How we prevent it](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/how-we-prevent-it/): Describes Google’s systems, reviews, and enforcement methods for traffic quality protection.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Practical steps advertisers and publishers can take to reduce invalid activity risks.

## Invalid Activity Education
- [Invalid activity](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/invalid-activity/): Overview of invalid clicks, impressions, and other non-genuine ad interactions.
- [Overview](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/overview/): High-level explanation of why traffic quality matters in digital advertising.
- [How we prevent it](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/how-we-prevent-it/): Details on detection and prevention mechanisms used across Google ad systems.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Recommendations for monitoring traffic sources and maintaining compliant implementations.

## Prevention and Enforcement
- [How we prevent it](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/how-we-prevent-it/): Explains automated and manual protections against invalid traffic and ad fraud.
- [Overview](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/overview/): Context for Google’s broader traffic quality and trust efforts.
- [Invalid activity](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/invalid-activity/): Background on the behaviors and patterns these protections are designed to detect.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Publisher and advertiser actions that complement Google’s prevention systems.

## Guidance for Advertisers
- [Resources for Advertisers](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/advertisers/): Advertiser-focused guidance for identifying, understanding, and mitigating invalid traffic concerns.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Best practices for campaign setup, monitoring, and traffic source evaluation.
- [Invalid activity](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/invalid-activity/): Helps advertisers understand suspicious interactions and non-valid engagement patterns.
- [How we prevent it](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/how-we-prevent-it/): Explains how Google filters and investigates invalid ad activity for advertisers.

## Guidance for Publishers
- [Resources for Publishers](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/publishers/): Publisher-focused guidance on preventing invalid traffic and maintaining account health.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Actions publishers can take to avoid accidental or malicious invalid activity.
- [Invalid activity](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/invalid-activity/): Describes traffic and implementation issues that can affect publisher monetization.
- [How we prevent it](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/how-we-prevent-it/): Outlines Google’s review and enforcement processes relevant to publishers.

## Audience-Specific Resources
- [Resources for Advertisers](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/advertisers/): Central hub for advertiser education and traffic quality support materials.
- [Resources for Publishers](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/publishers/): Central hub for publisher education and invalid activity prevention materials.
- [Overview](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/overview/): Shared introduction suitable for both advertisers and publishers.
- [What you can do](https://adtrafficquality.google/ads/adtrafficquality/what-you-can-do/): Cross-audience checklist for reducing exposure to invalid traffic.

- [Privacy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Google privacy policy covering data handling and user privacy practices.

- [Google Products](https://about.google/products/): Directory of Google products and services across consumer and business categories.
